input.summary: Ported fir.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fir.dp.cpp, with no dpct headers or helpers. The taps are captured by value in the kernel lambda in place of constant memory. The kernel is a 1-D nd_range that uses a local_accessor tile and group_barrier, with the same arithmetic as the CUDA version. Error-code plumbing was replaced by a catch for sycl::exception. It compiles cleanly with add_dpct_include=false. I did not run the binary or measure the -96 dBFS null against the reference, so numerical correctness is unchecked.
